towns.name: Qalaba'r
towns.summary: Qalaba'r (74.6S 19.6E) is the southernmost Gharu'ndim village, beyond the Yushad Ridge on the edge of the Linvak Mountains, the staging ground for treasure hunters raiding the Gotrok Lugian citadels and for travellers heading over the Southern Landbridge to the Direlands. Once a bustling place full of portal storms, it was nearly abandoned after frost elementals and glacial golems invaded and never fully recovered. The village sits on a flat plateau (z 102) ringed by a forest of giant trees (up to 70 m) with the Linvak foothills rising to the south-west: a small plaza with the nullified golem statue on its stone pedestal and the Town Network portal, two yellow-green domed halls, a stained-glass church tower, flat-roofed houses with rooftop gardens (The Four Shields, Tamara's Armory, House of Scrolls, Food and Clothing), a well and the Life Stone at the south-east edge; the Atrium Residential Halls portal and the Portal to Silyun lie close by.
